# Josue Mobile Auto Repair

> Mobile auto repair based in Austin, Texas. Josue fixes cars where they're parked: brakes, AC, fuel and suspension work across Austin. No tow, no waiting room, and honest advice on what you actually need.

- Phone: (512) 431-4152
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Del Valle, Buda, Pflugerville, Manor, Round Rock
- Google rating: 5.0 from 14 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/josue-mobile-auto-repair/quote.html
- Book a drop-off: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/auto-repair/texas/josue-mobile-auto-repair/book.html

## Services
- Brakes at home: Pads and rotors changed in your driveway, trucks included.
- AC repair: Compressor and clutch problems fixed without dealership hassle.
- Fuel & engine: Fuel gauges, injectors and engine diagnostics, on the spot.
- Suspension: Control arms and front-end parts swapped where the car sits.
- Used car inspections: A full look before you buy, with a plain-English list of what needs work.

## About
Josue works out of Southeast Austin and drives to his customers. Reviewers found him on Google and keep calling him back for the next car in the family. He's known for explaining the problem, helping people buy the right part themselves when it saves money, and picking up the phone.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you really come to me?
  A: Yes. Josue is a mobile mechanic and does most repairs where the car is parked.
- Q: What can be fixed in a driveway?
  A: Brakes, AC components, fuel parts, control arms, diagnostics and more. Bigger jobs, he'll tell you up front.
- Q: Do you work Saturdays?
  A: Yes, 8 AM to 2 PM, and weekdays 9 to 5.
- Q: Which areas do you cover?
  A: Austin and nearby towns including Del Valle, Buda, Manor, Pflugerville and Round Rock.
